name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.17: alert on repeated invalid machine-key attempts. A machine presenting a wrong key cannot authenticate anything — not sales, not the config poll, not the command queue that config_health rides on — so it cannot report its own state, and a key mistyped at setup produces silence indistinguishable from a machine that is switched off. The 401s are the only evidence it leaves, so they are now counted per device: five within fifteen minutes raises a critical alert and emails the operator, telling them the typed key is wrong and to re-read it with show key, deduped for six hours and cleared the moment the machine authenticates successfully. Attempts against an unregistered device code raise a warning instead, since that is either a machine being set up or something probing the API. Cumulative over v6.16.
